classification_reason: Durability/atomicity after recovery hold: 32 probe kills across two writes (plus 42 manual write kills and 20 attempts to kill the recovery itself, 17 of which landed before it finished), and every trial ended in pre-state or the complete committed shape. No PARTIAL outcome, and no state the next command could not recover from, including kills of the recovery itself. But isolation fails: between a kill and the next lock-taking command, inspect/search show uncommitted content that recovery later undoes, and validate/status say nothing about the pending journal.

consumer.goal: Prepare one valid capture.create and one stage.progress.update envelope, interrupt each at ≥10 points, classify what is left
commands: los capability capture.create (try1: INVALID_REQUEST 'not valid under any of the given schemas')
los capability capture.create (try2: UNCONFIRMED approval subject mismatch)
los capability capture.create (try3: INVALID_REQUEST missing capture-request:idem-s17-try3)
manual kill + reads (status, validate, inspect, search, resume, plan-edit-context, bootstrap --brief, operations, intelligence-scan)
kill los generate during rollback at 20 delays 0.1–1.0 (17 landed)
retry same envelope after kill (both capabilities)
confusions: WORKFLOWS §25a lists the envelope fields but not the channel enum, the approval object shape, or how intent_sha256 is computed
first envelope error 'is not valid under any of the given schemas' prints the whole envelope but names no field
capture.create must guard 'capture-request:<idempotency_key>' at revision 0; learned only from the error message
los operations aggregates traces across git resets (store is gitignored), so after the probe it reported execution_outcome 'committed' for a request that the current repository had never committed
corrective_steps: read the product's intent_sha256 implementation and computed the approval subject with it
consumer.outcome: No write was ever left half-applied after recovery. The same envelope resubmitted after a kill rolls back the orphan and commits exactly once. But until some lock-taking command runs, a user asking `inspect` sees a 'paused' stage that is not actually recorded, and `validate` says the repository is OK.

internal.transaction_behavior: Journal-first: .inflight/<txn>/intent.json (+ backup-N per overwritten file) written before canonical files; receipt + idempotency.yaml + revisions.yaml at commit. Recovery (on lock: generate, plan-edit-context, bootstrap --brief, any capability submit) restores backups or completes a receipted commit, and is itself idempotent: rollback killed after the file restore leaves only the journal, which the next command removes.
internal.approval_behavior: approval.subject_sha256 must equal intent_sha256 over {schema_version, capability, channel, expected_snapshot, expected_revisions, payload}; a mismatch → UNCONFIRMED; the expected value is not leaked.
internal.projection_activity: los generate republishes manifest after each recovery
internal.persistence_activity: capture: work/inbox/<ts>-s17-probe.md; stage progress: study-map.yaml, unit.yaml, resume.yaml
unexpected_writes: stage.progress.update 'paused' on one stage also set the whole unit.yaml and study-map status to paused
curriculum/resume.yaml is rewritten (updated date) but is not an expected_revisions artifact
warnings_errors: HYGIENE-VIEWS after each kill (manifest not current authored snapshot)
no warning/error for the pending .inflight journal
internal.git_diff_stat: world reset to HEAD after the probe; S17-before→after canonical diff empty

capture.create.per_delay: 0.01,0.05,0.1,0.15 → pre-state, nothing on disk; 0.2–0.65 (10 delays) → before recovery: inbox file + revisions.yaml + .inflight/<txn>/intent.json, no receipt, status inbox 8 (exposed); after `los generate` → pre-state; 0.7 → committed (receipt, no journal); 0.75 → finished

stage.progress.update.per_delay: 0.01–0.2 → pre-state, nothing on disk; 0.25–0.75 (11 delays) → before recovery: 3 files rewritten, journal intent.json + backup-0..2, no receipt (exposed); after generate → pre-state; 0.8 → killed after receipt, journal still present (exposed) → after generate committed; 0.9 → finished

scenario_record.leftover_journal_files: only before recovery; none after any recovery command

read_behaviour_after_kill.operations: no recovery; diagnosis AMBIGUOUS, 'reconcile-exact-request', ui_outcome BLOCKED

scenario_record.recovery_interrupted: los generate started after a killed write and itself SIGKILLed at 20 delays 0.1–1.0 s (17 killed; 0.5, 0.7, 1.0 finished first): at 0.12–0.13 files still uncommitted + journal; at 0.14–0.15 files restored but journal left; ≥0.155 fully recovered; in every case the next generate finished recovery, exit 0
scenario_record.retry_same_envelope_after_kill: capture: ok, new file 20260925-042811-s17-probe.md, orphan 042753 removed, exactly one file + one receipt; stage progress: ok, committed once, operations then reports COMMITTED / SETTLED

uncertainties: Only SIGKILL of the whole process group was tested, not power loss (fsync ordering)
Whether the UI (Obsidian) triggers recovery on its reads is NOT TESTED
